body:
## Summary
- Add rich hover/focus preview tooltips to pipeline stage numbers and album track numbers.
- Preview frames use each stage resolution as the displayed aspect ratio and include preset/resolution metadata for accessibility.
- Store issue research, raw GitHub data, and verification screenshot under docs/case-studies/issue-137.

## Reproduce
1. Open the example app and switch to the Pipeline tab.
2. Hover a stage number or an album track number.
3. Confirm a visualization preview appears with the stage's configured aspect ratio.

## Tests
- npm run build
- npm test -- --runInBand
- npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js

## Screenshot
![Pipeline preview tooltip](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-137-21ca5ac03c0b/docs/case-studies/issue-137/screenshots/issue-137-pipeline-preview-tooltip.png?raw=true)


Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#137
